newsitem.title: UK: Grandmet says no merit in potential claim.
newsitem.headline: Grandmet says no merit in potential claim.

text.p: British food and drinks group Grand Metropolitan Plc rejected on Tuesday a potential legal claim from debt-ladened leisure company Brent Walker Group Plc.
"As far as we are concerned there is no merit in the claim," said a spokesman at GrandMet.
The dispute surrounds Brent Walker's 685 million stg acquisition of Britain's third largest betting chain William Hill from GrandMet in September 1989.
An article in the Independent newspaper said Brent Walker planned to start legal proceedings, but GrandMet said it was not aware of any action. No one at Brent Walker was available to comment.
